title: Formal Substrate Consolidation Review
purpose: Review FSUB-001 through FSUB-009 and determine whether the local theorem substrate is ready for restricted proof-candidate work.
review_findings: State spaces successfully define core variables (x_alpha, omega_alpha, R_alpha) with local domain restrictions.
Admissibility spaces provide formal definitions for constraint regions and boundary behavior.
Equivalence relations are rigorously defined with explicit preserved/discarded feature sets.
Operator signatures for Pi_A, NavT, and delta are hardened with clear pre/postconditions.
Composition rules effectively block hidden sequentialization and identity collapse.
Selection semantics clarify delta behavior under degeneracy and failure conditions.
Failure modes are successfully formalized as first-class structural information objects.
MT-001, MT-002, and MT-003 are explicitly bound to their required substrate objects.
remaining_risks: Substrate objects remain symbolic constructs; local theorem work must not overclaim 'truth'.
Recursive depth limits are qualitative and require further refinement during candidate review.
Composition loss declarations depend on auditor thoroughness.
forbidden_next_steps: Claiming theorem proof from substrate definitions alone.
